jobPostingInfo.title: Logistics Operations Support
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
This role is critical in converting monthly trade flow requirements into optimized, cost-effective transport plans that support LAI’s margin objectives. The successful candidate will be based in DRC

Responsibilities

  • Manage local trucking business in Kolwezi for Cu going to the warehouse for rail transport to Lobito, and sulphur going the other way
  • Currently at > 30,000 MT per month with 8 LSPs, and forecast to double by year end
  • Plan for uplift between LSPs and forecast and report the plan to the team and customers • Daily tracking and reporting showing progress
  • Identify any areas of shortfall and inform + propose solutions
